name: io.github.Fonteum/mcp-server
title: Fonteum — Public Records & Sanctions
description: Multi-vertical public-records: 111 active source families in the provenance ledger as of 2026-07-12.

tools.name: fonteum_resolve_entity
tools.description: Resolve an entity by NPI, UEI, or CAGE and return available healthcare or federal-procurement records with their source context.

tools.name: fonteum_search_records
tools.description: Search US healthcare records by vertical and state, with optional county context.

tools.name: fonteum_check_exclusions_and_sanctions
tools.description: Check an NPI or name against applicable US exclusion, debarment, and sanctions lists; re-confirm material matches with the issuing authority.

tools.name: fonteum_get_record_as_of
tools.description: Return a federal contractor record as captured on a supplied date, using a UEI or CAGE identifier.

tools.name: fonteum_recheck
tools.description: Return source and capture information to support a follow-up check of a Fonteum record.

tools.name: fonteum_list_sources
tools.description: List Fonteum's public multi-vertical source catalog and separately report the dated active-ledger count, with authority, coverage, refresh information, and official source URLs.

tools.name: fonteum_dataset_info
tools.description: Return published methodology, scope, and source-catalog metadata for the current MCP service.
